title: ready-02: the connection — clients attach to the server over a local socket; RPC, events, detach/attach
summary: The local socket carries client-server traffic and scripts' RPC lines; windows detach and attach; several windows per session.
description:
Second step of the server/client model (F012 decisions d108b88c, 463ccd07, 2c249a29). The server holds the shared content; a window is a client with its own view; **standalone = server + one client in one process, one code path**. This phase carries the in-process server↔client interface over a local socket and makes a session **outlive its window** (detach/attach, like tmux).

## The model — shared context every task here draws on
- **In-process interface today:** `AppState.ask_server(ServerAction)` → `Change` (heca/src/server/change.rs) → `window_reacts` (heca/src/app_state/reaction/mod.rs). The server reads per-window facts from the `Asker` (heca/src/server/cx.rs: focused_pane, workspace, column, area, cell), never from a window. Per-window view is `WindowView`/`ScrollView` (heca-core/src/layout/window_view.rs), split out in P104.
- **Terminal data** is already separate from drawing (heca-core/src/backend/snapshot.rs: `TerminalSnapshot`/`TerminalDamage`) — but it holds wezterm cells + decoded images, so the **wire form must be plain data**, never those types.
- **RPC language:** heca/src/rpc.rs (parse / into_intent / introspect, all via the `ActionCatalog`). CLI table: heca/src/app/cli.rs.

## Tasks
- **T521 — DONE.** Local-only, owner-only socket + `heca rpc <line>`: heca/src/server/socket.rs, the `AppEvent::Rpc` seam (heca/src/app/events.rs, handled in lib.rs). Scripts reach any catalogued action (one-shot). Unix only so far.
- **T543** serializable wire model (plain-data Change + snapshot/damage + layout effects; add serde to heca-core).
- **T544** headless server (no window) + attach protocol; detach on close, reattach with scrollback.
- **T545** several windows per session + `follow` + pane size setting (smallest|latest|largest, default latest).
- **T546** `heca rpc --events` stream · **T547** Windows named pipe · **T548** docs.

## Done when
Close the window while a long command runs; `heca` again attaches and it is still running with its scrollback. Two windows on one session move independently; typing in one resizes a shared pane per the setting. `heca rpc split_horizontal` works from a shell (done).

tasks.title: Serializable wire model — plain-data Change + terminal snapshot/damage + layout effects
tasks.description:
ready-02b. Make the server→client interface serializable so the socket can carry it. Today it is in-process only and **heca-core has no serde dependency at all**.

In scope: `Change` (heca/src/server/change.rs), the layout effects `SpaceEffect`/`PaneEffect`/`ColumnEffect` (heca-core/src/layout/scrolling/{pane_effect,effect}.rs) and geometry `Point`/`Size`/`Rectangle` + ids (heca-core/src/layout/types.rs), and a terminal snapshot + changed rows.

KEY DECISION: `TerminalSnapshot`/`TerminalDamage` (heca-core/src/backend/snapshot.rs) hold wezterm cell data and decoded images — do NOT derive serde on them. Define a NEW plain-data wire snapshot (styled text runs, colours, cursor, viewport offset; images referenced by content-hash/handle, bytes fetched separately) that the in-memory snapshot converts into. Add serde (derive, workspace dep) to heca-core.

Done when: every message the socket needs round-trips through serde in unit tests, and no wezterm/image type appears in the wire form. Depends on T521.

tasks.title: Headless server process + attach protocol (detach/attach)
tasks.description:
ready-02c. The server must run **without a window** so a session survives the window closing (detach/attach, decision d108b88c).

Current: `ServerState` (heca/src/server/mod.rs) is built inside the window process via `AppState`; the in-process interface is `AppState.ask_server(ServerAction)` → `Change` → `window_reacts` (heca/src/app_state/reaction/mod.rs). T521 built the socket + the `AppEvent::Rpc` seam (heca/src/server/socket.rs).

This task carries that SAME interface over the socket: a window attaches as a pure client — sends actions + input, receives `Change`s + terminal snapshots/changed rows (the wire model, T543). `heca` with no server starts one in the background and attaches; closing the window detaches and the server keeps running; `heca` again reattaches with scrollback intact. ONE code path: standalone = server + one in-process client, identical to attaching over the socket.

Edge cases: a stale socket from a crashed server; a slow client must never block the server. Done when: close the window mid-command, `heca` reattaches and it is still running. Depends on T543.

tasks.title: Several windows per session — own view each, follow, pane size setting
tasks.description:
ready-02d. Several windows attach to one session (decision 463ccd07): shared content, each its own view.

The per-window view already exists — `WindowView`/`ScrollView` (heca-core/src/layout/window_view.rs), split out in P104 — and the server reads what it needs from the per-request `Asker` (heca/src/server/cx.rs: `focused_pane`, `workspace`, `column`, `area`, `cell`), never from a window.

Add: a `follow` option so one window mirrors another; and — because a running terminal has ONE size while several windows show it at different sizes — a setting `smallest | latest | largest` (default `latest` = the window last typed in), decided server-side on the resize event (heca/src/app/terminal_host/input.rs::on_resize feeds it today). Add the setting to config.default.toml + README.

Done when: two windows on one session move independently, and typing in one resizes a shared pane per the setting. Depends on T544.

tasks.title: `heca rpc --events` — stream events to scripts
tasks.description:
ready-02e. `heca rpc --events` streams the session's events to a script over the socket — the same `Change`s a window reacts to (heca/src/server/change.rs), serialized via the wire model (T543).

Extend the socket client (heca/src/server/socket.rs — a streaming request that stays open and prints each event as a line) and the server side to fan events out to subscribed connections (a subscriber list beside the per-request handling T521 added). Keep it one way in: the events are the existing `Change`s, nothing invented per event.

Done when: `heca rpc --events` in a shell prints events as the session changes (a split made in another window shows up). Depends on T544.

tasks.title: Windows named-pipe transport
tasks.description:
ready-02f. The Windows transport for the control socket: a named pipe, owner-only, behind the SAME functions the Unix socket exposes.

Today heca/src/server/socket.rs is `cfg(unix)` (`serve`/`request`/`run_rpc_cli`/`socket_path`, using `std::os::unix::net::UnixListener`/`UnixStream`); lib.rs and cli.rs call it behind `#[cfg(unix)]`. Add a `cfg(windows)` implementation of the same surface (a named pipe under `\\.\pipe\heca\…`, owner-only ACL) so lib.rs/cli.rs call it unchanged — one interface, two transports.

Done when: `heca rpc <line>` works on Windows against a running heca. Depends on T521.

Document the connection — extend docs/server-client-architecture.md (written in T525, P104): the local-only owner-only socket + runtime folder, `heca rpc <line>` and `--events`, the attach/detach model and the one-code-path (standalone = server + one in-process client), several windows + the pane size setting (`smallest|latest|largest`, default `latest`), and the wire model (plain-data snapshot, no wezterm/image types on the wire). Both audiences, concise, cross-referencing the F012 decisions (d108b88c, 463ccd07, 2c249a29).

Done when the doc matches the shipped behaviour. Depends on T544/T545.
